summary: Iteration 15 frontend testing completed for Equipment Quote Module dynamic selection logic. All 8 feature requirements passed. Wizard implements: (1) Dispositivos selection shows secondary POS/Pinpad dropdown, (2) Accesorios selection has no secondary dropdown and enables Step 3 directly, (3) POS filtering shows only POS-type items, (4) Pinpad filtering shows only Pinpad-type items, (5) Accesorios filtering shows Accesorio+Base types, (6) Confirmation modal appears before PDF with client data and total, (7) Unified quotes panel shows all categories in single table, (8) CATEGORÍA column displays Implementación/Equipos badges.

issues: Minor hydration warning in console: '<tr> cannot be child of <span>' - React dynamic rendering artifact, does not affect functionality

dynamic_selection_dispositivos.description: Selecting 'Dispositivos' shows secondary dropdown with POS and Pinpad options

dynamic_selection_accesorios.description: Selecting 'Accesorios' does NOT show secondary dropdown, enables Step 3 directly

filter_pos_products.description: When Dispositivos > POS selected, Step 3 shows only POS-type items (Morefun MF960)

filter_pinpad_products.description: When Dispositivos > Pinpad selected, Step 3 shows only Pinpad-type items

filter_accesorio_products.description: When Accesorios selected, Step 3 shows Accesorio AND Base types

confirmation_modal.description: Modal appears before PDF generation showing client name, RIF, type, items count, and total

unified_quotes_panel.description: Single table shows all quotes without tabs, with CATEGORÍA column

wizard_step_flow.step1: Client selection - disabled Next until client selected
wizard_step_flow.step2_dispositivo: Category + Subtype selection - secondary dropdown appears, Next disabled until subtype selected
wizard_step_flow.step2_accesorio: Category selection only - no secondary dropdown, Next enabled immediately
wizard_step_flow.step3: Product selection with filtered items based on Step 2 selection
